prints records from the state, the logs or the blocks

Usage: dolos data dump [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  state   dumps the entities of a state namespace
  logs    dumps the records of a log namespace
  blocks  dumps the archive's blocks
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
